teaching.title: Peer Programming Mentor
bullets: Supported beginner practice sessions on debugging and functions, helping peers trace short programs step by step.
Explained worked examples on debugging and functions under a course instructor's supervision as a peer programming mentor.

projects.title: Command-Line Text Utility
bullets: Implemented a small command-line text utility in C with explicit memory handling, using Git for the project.
Traced program behaviour using a debugger and documented the program structure and test cases.

projects.title: Set Operation Explorer
bullets: Translated discrete mathematical definitions into Python program functions for a set operation explorer.
Constructed examples and counterexamples for the represented rules and tested the implementation against hand-worked cases.
